title: Handle a stream error
summary: catchError can replace a failed stream with another observable.
introduction: catchError can replace a failed stream with another observable. Your task: Replace the empty list with a visible fallback message stream.
learningObjectives: Replace the empty list with a visible fallback message stream.
Explain the example for handle a stream error

blocks.text: catchError can replace a failed stream with another observable. A fallback can give the caller a useful value instead of an unhandled failure.
Use a JavaScript or TypeScript project with RxJS 7 installed. Run imports through the project tool. Browser event examples need the stated HTML element. This site does not include RxJS in its runner.
Read the code step by step

items: `catchError` returns a replacement observable after an error. Decide what the UI should explain about that failure.
`subscribe` registers a listener. For a stream or store that stays active, keep and use its cleanup handle.

blocks.text: The fallback emits an empty list, so the console shows 0.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Return an observable from catchError. Also decide whether the UI should explain the error instead of silently hiding it.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Replace the empty list with a visible fallback message stream.
